scope: 2016 revision of fibromyalgia criteria and non-drug management, from the same open review used for catalogue 648.

keyRecommendations.text: The 2016 revision added a generalised pain requirement to reduce misclassification.
The 2011 simplification replaced physician assessment of symptom extent with three patient-reported symptoms.
A 2020 comparison found substantial agreement among ACR 2011, ACR 2016, AAPT, and modified FAS criteria.

clinicalBottomLine: The 2016 criteria keep the symptom-based WPI and symptom-severity approach and add a generalised pain requirement. Education, exercise, and psychological therapy stay first-line.
notableCaveats: Central sensitisation is not given a numeric test in the passages used. A mouse IgG transfer study is mentioned as support for an immune contribution and is not turned into a clinical test.
